title.zh: Senate tax bill frees stablecoin spending while Bitcoin stays on IRS forms
title.en: Senate tax bill frees stablecoin spending while Bitcoin stays on IRS forms

current_state.zh: A newly released Senate draft, the ADAPT Act, would spare qualifying stablecoin purchases from capital gain or loss recognition while keeping Bitcoin spending subject to disposition reporting.
